## Network Topology Map

<div id="network-graph"
     style="height:500px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;background:#fafafa;">
</div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
let allNodes = [];
let mheardMode = "ALL";
let networkInstance = null;

function parseTime(st) {
  let t = st.lastHeard;
  if (t && !t.endsWith("Z") && !t.includes("+")) t += "Z";
  return Date.parse(t);
}

function formatUTC(ts) {
  return new Date(ts)
    .toISOString()
    .substring(0, 19)
    .replace("T", " ") + " UTC";
}

async function fetchDashboardData() {
  const base = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";

  const [linksRes, mheardRes, nodesRes] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(base + "/links"),
    fetch(base + "/mheard"),
    fetch(base + "/nodes")
  ]);

  if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok || !nodesRes.ok)
    throw new Error("API failure");

  const links = (await linksRes.json()).links || [];
  const rawMheard = (await mheardRes.json()).mheard || [];
  allNodes = (await nodesRes.json()).nodes || [];

  const twelveHoursAgo = Date.now() - (12 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const mheard = rawMheard
    .map(st => ({ ...st, ts: parseTime(st) }))
    .filter(st => !isNaN(st.ts) && st.ts >= twelveHoursAgo)
    .sort((a,b) => b.ts - a.ts);

  // ---------------- FEED ----------------
  document.getElementById("activity-feed-container").innerHTML =
    mheard.map(st => {
      const color = Number(st.port) === 1 ? "#2e7d32" : "#1565c0";

      return `
        <div style="margin-bottom:4px;">
          🕒 ${formatUTC(st.ts)}
          <span style="color:${color};font-weight:bold;">
            Heard ${st.callSign}
          </span>
          on Port ${st.port}
        </div>`;
    }).join("") || "<p style='color:#666;'>No recent activity</p>";

  // ---------------- LINKS ----------------
  document.getElementById("links-container").innerHTML =
    links.length === 0
      ? "<p>No active links</p>"
      : `
      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-family:monospace;">
        <tr style="background:#f1f1f1;">
          <th>Node</th><th>Port</th><th>Type</th><th>Status</th>
        </tr>
        ${links.map(l => {
          const up = ["ACTIVE","ESTABLISHED","CONNECTED"]
            .includes((l.state||"").toUpperCase());

          return `
            <tr>
              <td>${l.farCall}</td>
              <td>${l.port}</td>
              <td>${l.linkType || "AXUDP"}</td>
              <td>
                <span style="
                  padding:3px 8px;
                  border-radius:4px;
                  font-size:12px;
                  color:${up ? "#155724" : "#721c24"};
                  background:${up ? "#d4edda" : "#f8d7da"};
                  font-weight:bold;">
                  ${l.state || "ACTIVE"}
                </span>
              </td>
            </tr>`;
        }).join("")}
      </table>`;

  // ---------------- MHEARD ----------------
  const filtered = mheard.filter(st => {
    if (mheardMode === "RF") return Number(st.port) === 1;
    if (mheardMode === "AXIP") return Number(st.port) === 3;
    return true;
  });

  document.getElementById("mheard-container").innerHTML =
    filtered.length === 0
      ? "<p>No stations</p>"
      : `
      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-family:monospace;">
        <tr style="background:#f1f1f1;">
          <th>Call</th><th>Port</th><th>Packets</th><th>Last Heard</th>
        </tr>
        ${filtered.map(st => {
          const color = Number(st.port) === 1 ? "#2e7d32" : "#1565c0";
          return `
            <tr>
              <td style="color:${color};font-weight:bold;">${st.callSign}</td>
              <td>${st.port}</td>
              <td>${Number(st.packets||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
              <td>${formatUTC(st.ts)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        }).join("")}
      </table>`;

  // ---------------- METRICS ----------------
  let rf = 0, axip = 0, latest = 0, latestCall = "";

  mheard.forEach(st => {
    if (st.ts > latest) {
      latest = st.ts;
      latestCall = st.callSign;
    }
    if (st.ts >= Date.now() - 4*60*60*1000) {
      if (Number(st.port) === 1) rf++;
      if (Number(st.port) === 3) axip++;
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("w-links").innerText = links.length;
  document.getElementById("w-rf").innerText = rf;
  document.getElementById("w-axip").innerText = axip;

  document.getElementById("w-last").innerText =
    latest ? `${latestCall} - ${Math.floor((Date.now()-latest)/60000)} mins ago` : "No data";

  document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = "Operational";

  renderNodes(allNodes);

  // ✅ FIX: ensure vis container is ready before rendering
  setTimeout(() => {
    const el = document.getElementById("network-graph");
    if (!el) return;

    renderGraph(allNodes, mheard);
  }, 50);
}

// ---------------- NODES ----------------
function renderNodes(list) {
  const el = document.getElementById("nodes-container");

  if (!list.length) {
    el.innerHTML = "<p style='color:#666;'>No matching nodes</p>";
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = `
    <div style="
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap:10px;
    ">
      ${list.map(n => `
        <div style="
          background:white;
          border:1px solid #e2e8f0;
          padding:10px 12px;
          border-radius:6px;
          box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
        ">
          <div style="font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50;">
            ${n.Call}
            ${n.Alias ? `<span style="color:#e67e22;"> :${n.Alias}</span>` : ""}
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:0.85em;color:#7f8c8d;">
            🗺️ Routes: <strong>${n.Routes?.length || 0}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join("")}
    </div>
  `;
}

// ---------------- GRAPH ----------------
function buildTopology(nodes, mheard) {
  const edges = new Map();
  const windowMs = 30 * 60 * 1000;

  const events = mheard.map(m => ({
    call: m.callSign,
    port: Number(m.port),
    ts: m.ts
  }));

  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < events.length; j++) {
      const a = events[i], b = events[j];

      if (Math.abs(a.ts - b.ts) > windowMs) continue;
      if (a.call === b.call) continue;

      const key = [a.call, b.call].sort().join("|");

      if (!edges.has(key)) {
        edges.set(key, { from: a.call, to: b.call, weight: 0, rf: 0, axip: 0 });
      }

      const e = edges.get(key);
      e.weight++;

      if (a.port === 1 || b.port === 1) e.rf++;
      if (a.port === 3 || b.port === 3) e.axip++;
    }
  }

  return Array.from(edges.values());
}

function renderGraph(nodes, mheard) {
  const container = document.getElementById("network-graph");
  if (!container) return;

  container.innerHTML = ""; // ✅ critical fix

  const nodeSet = new vis.DataSet();
  const edgeSet = new vis.DataSet();

  const topology = buildTopology(nodes, mheard);

  nodes.forEach(n => {
    nodeSet.add({
      id: n.Call,
      label: n.Call,
      shape: "box",
      color: { background: "#fff", border: "#2c3e50" }
    });
  });

  topology.forEach(e => {
    const isRF = e.rf > e.axip;

    edgeSet.add({
      from: e.from,
      to: e.to,
      value: Math.min(5, e.weight),
      color: isRF ? "#2e7d32" : "#1565c0"
    });
  });

  if (networkInstance) networkInstance.destroy();

  networkInstance = new vis.Network(container, {
    nodes: nodeSet,
    edges: edgeSet
  }, {
    physics: {
      stabilization: true,
      barnesHut: { gravitationalConstant: -4000, springLength: 140 }
    },
    interaction: { hover: true }
  });
}

// ---------------- EVENTS ----------------
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchDashboardData();
  setInterval(fetchDashboardData, 60000);

  document.getElementById("btn-rf").onclick = () => {
    mheardMode = "RF";
    fetchDashboardData();
  };

  document.getElementById("btn-axip").onclick = () => {
    mheardMode = "AXIP";
    fetchDashboardData();
  };

  document.getElementById("node-search").addEventListener("input", e => {
    const t = e.target.value.toUpperCase();
    renderNodes(allNodes.filter(n =>
      n.Call.toUpperCase().includes(t) ||
      (n.Alias || "").toUpperCase().includes(t)
    ));
  });
});
</script>
